creaite 1.9.5 · first day

Claude drafts. You approve. creaite keeps the record.

creaite reads your meetings, mail and Teams, proposes the actions, decisions, risks and issues it finds, and keeps them in one tracker once you approve. Everything stays in one folder on your laptop.

The loop

Every piece of work follows the same five steps. Only step 3 needs you, and nothing reaches the tracker without it.

1 · IN

Material arrives

  • Meetings picked from your calendar (Intake › Calendar import)
  • Transcripts and minutes you drop in (Upload files)
  • Notes from a call (Quick capture)
  • The daily mail and Teams sweep
2 · PROPOSE

Claude drafts

Draft Word minutes, plus proposed new items and updates to open ones, each citing its source. It matches every item to a project and owner.

3 · YOU

Review

In Review, approve, edit or reject each proposal. Routine items can be approved in bulk; minutes, new decisions and new risks are approved one at a time.

The only gate
4 · RECORD

Apply

Apply writes what you approved to the tracker and files the minutes in the project folder. Every apply can be undone.

5 · OUT

See and report

The dashboard updates at once. Weekly and client reports are drafted in Word from the tracker, and you approve them before they're filed.

The next meeting starts the loop again. When a meeting discusses an item that's still open, Claude proposes an update to it, never a duplicate.

Once

Your first hour

About an hour, most of it telling creaite about your projects and the people on them.

1

Install

Download creaite-1.9.5.zip from the release, not "Source code". Run python3 ~/Downloads/creaite-1.9.5.zip and choose a folder outside OneDrive and iCloud.

2

Say "setup"

Open the folder in Claude Code, connect Microsoft 365, and say setup. It asks before each step: git, your name and role, projects, people, a memory file for each project, and the creaite launcher (say yes).

3

Open creaite

double-click the creaite app in your Applications folder (or creaite.command in the vault). It starts the live server and opens creaite in its own Chrome window. If you have no launcher yet: in Terminal, system/scripts/run live_server.py, then open the address it prints in Chrome or Edge, not Safari.

4

First sweep

Let setup run the first sweep over the last 14 days, or press Run the first sweep on Today. Then open Review and approve what's right. Until set-up is done, Today shows a short checklist of these steps, each with its button. Settings › Health › Set-up runs the health check and rebuilds the views from the page, and says how to do the two things it can't (connect Microsoft 365, make the launcher), with Copy and Check again.

Every day

The rhythm

First session after 07:00

It catches up

creaite backs up the tracker, runs the mail and Teams sweep if it's due, and lists reminders and what's waiting.

After a meeting

Bring it in

On Intake, pick the meeting in Calendar import or drop its transcript in Upload files, then process it into minutes and proposals.

Whenever it suits

Review and apply

Clear Review in minutes. Then check Today for what's overdue, due and changed.

Friday from 12:00

Report

A reminder to run the weekly report. Client reports come on each project's own schedule.

The dashboard

Where things are

Every edit you make on the dashboard is written as a proposal and applied at once, with Undo.

TodayA morning brief: your meetings, what needs attention, your commitments, what was resolved, the week ahead
IntakeThree ways in: Calendar import, Upload files and Quick capture
ProjectsCurrent state, health checked against evidence, milestones, early warnings
WorkEvery action, risk, issue and decision, with filters and saved views
PeopleEach person's open work, Draft email, and handover
ReviewProposals grouped by project, nested under their minutes
FilesMinutes, transcripts, documents and reports, with search that answers with sources
Settings(the gear): Sweep time, reminders, health rules, registers, themes
⌘K search or jump anywhere⌘J ask creaite, the assistantJ/K, A, R move, approve and reject in Review
Phrasebook

Say this in Claude Code or ask creaite

Plain English works. These are the phrases each skill listens for.

SayWhat happens
process new minutesTranscripts become draft Word minutes and proposed items in Review.
sweepOutlook and Teams since the last sweep become proposals. It also runs by itself each morning.
review · applyGo through what's pending, then write the approved items to the tracker. undo last apply reverses it.
mark ABC-A-003 doneAny change in plain words, shown before → after, then applied.
weekly reportHealth with reasons, an update, and a Word report for each project, filed when you approve.
client report ABCA client-safe Word report. Only items marked client-visible appear in it.
actions register for ABCA one-off branded Word document from the tracker.
how is ABC going?An answer from the project's memory, the tracker and the files, with sources.
setup · update creaiteHealth check and repair. Install a new release, shown first, with your data kept.
Never bends

Four rules

Local onlyAll project data stays in the vault folder on your laptop. Never cloud folders, never shared.
You approve every writeClaude proposes; nothing reaches the tracker until you approve and apply. Scheduled runs only propose.
A source on every rowEvery item names the meeting, email or chat it came from, so you can always check it.
Client-safe by defaultClient reports show only what you've marked client-visible. Confidential material stays out.
Dates are shown DD-MM-YYYY. Keep the live server running while you use the dashboard. If it stops, a red alert appears across the top with the command to start it and Check again, and your edits wait until it's back; while it runs there is nothing to see. When mail and Teams were last swept, and when the data was built, are in Settings › Health › Live server and backups.How-to: step-by-step for common jobs ›
